groups.title: Pipe
groups.summary: Carbon steel, stainless steel and chromoly pipe, welded and seamless, stocked in Baytown.
groups.intro: SMP Supply is proud to stock some of the finest pipe in the world and distribute it to our valued customers. The grades and sizes below are what we commonly keep on the shelf; additional sizes and specs are sourced and purchased from our manufacturing partners on request.

services.title: Carbon Steel Pipe
services.text: Welded and seamless carbon steel pipe, including high yield, kept in commonly ordered sizes.
points: High yield grades listed on our line sheet

services.title: Stainless Steel Pipe
services.text: Welded and seamless stainless steel pipe in the same size range we carry in carbon.

services.title: Chromoly Pipe
services.text: Welded and seamless chromoly pipe for high temperature and high pressure service.
points: Grades P5, P9, P11 and P22

services.title: Coated and Lined Pipe
services.text: Pipe supplied with the coating or lining the line calls for.

groups.title: Valves
groups.summary: A vast variety of valves for all of your flow control needs, cast and forged, 150# to 2500#.
groups.intro: SMP Supply maintains a vast variety of valves for all of your flow control needs, cast and forged. The types, specifications and pressure classes below are what we commonly stock, and we can source and purchase additional sizes and specs from our manufacturing partners on request.
groups.imageAlt: A row of Grove trunnion ball valves on pallets in the warehouse

services.title: Ball Valves
services.text: Floating and trunnion mounted ball valves to API-6D, 598, 607 and 608.

services.title: Gate Valves
services.text: Compact, expanding, slab and wedge gate valves to API-6D, 600 and 602.

services.title: Globe Valves
services.text: T pattern and Y pattern globe valves to API-6D, 602, 603 and 623.

services.title: Plug Valves
services.text: Double block and bleed and lubricated plug valves to API-6D.

services.title: Check Valves
services.text: Swing, piston and wafer check valves to API-6D, 598, 600 and 602.

services.title: Butterfly Valves
services.text: Triple offset, high performance, TOV and resilient seated butterfly valves to API 609.

groups.title: Fittings & Flanges
groups.summary: Fittings, flanges, olets, gaskets and nuts and bolts for all of your industry needs.
groups.intro: SMP Supply stocks fittings, flanges, olets, gaskets, and nuts & bolts for all of your industry needs. Below is a list of our commonly stocked fittings and flanges; additional sizes and specs are sourced and purchased from our manufacturing partners.

services.title: Buttweld Fittings
services.text: Carbon steel, high yield, stainless steel and chromoly buttweld fittings, welded and seamless.
points: 90 and 45 elbows, straight and reducing tees, stub ends, reducers, laterals
Welded, 1/2" up to 72"; seamless, 1/2" up to 24"
Chromoly seamless, 4" up to 48", grades P5, P9, P11 and P22

services.title: Forged Fittings
services.text: Threaded and socket weld forged fittings in carbon steel, high yield, stainless steel and chromoly.

services.title: Flanges
services.text: Carbon steel, high yield and stainless steel flanges in the faces and classes your spec calls for.
points: Weld neck, slip-on, blind, socket weld, threaded and lap joint

services.title: Olets
services.text: Branch connections stocked alongside the fittings they run with.

services.title: Gaskets
services.text: Gaskets and insulation kits to go with the flanges on the same order.

services.title: Nuts & Bolts
services.text: Stud bolts and nuts in the grades and finishes the job calls for.
points: Black, cadmium plated and Teflon coated

groups.title: Valve Services
groups.summary: End modifications, trim changes, pipe pups, automation and testing, handled before the valve ships.
groups.intro: Valves do not always leave the manufacturer in the configuration a job needs. SMP Supply changes ends and trim, adds pipe pups, automates valves and tests them before they go out.
groups.imageAlt: An automated ball valve on a pallet beside wrapped valves loaded on a flatbed trailer

services.title: End Modifications
services.text: Valve ends modified to the connection the line requires.

services.title: Trim Changes
services.text: Valve trim changed to the materials called for by the service.

services.title: Pipe Pups
services.text: Pipe pups welded to valve ends so the valve arrives ready to tie in.

services.title: Valve Automation
services.text: Valves fitted with actuators and mounted hardware before they ship.

services.title: Witness Testing
services.text: Testing carried out with your inspector present to witness it.

services.title: Hydro Testing
services.text: Hydrostatic testing of valves before they leave.

groups.title: Machining & Fabrication
groups.summary: Machining, material verification, structural shims, coating and off-site support fabrication.
groups.intro: Alongside the warehouse, SMP Supply offers machining and structural fabrication services. Material is verified, flanges and bores are machined to the drawing, and supports are fabricated, coated and galvanized off site.
groups.imageAlt: A machinist at the control panel of a shop machine

services.title: Taper Bore
services.text: Bores tapered to the dimensions on the drawing.

services.title: Drill & Tap
services.text: Holes drilled and tapped to the spec supplied with the order.

services.title: Orifice Flanges
services.text: Orifice flanges machined and supplied for metering runs.

services.title: PMI Testing
services.text: Positive material identification to confirm the alloy before material goes out.

services.title: Structural Shims
services.text: Structural shims cut to the sizes a job calls for.

services.title: Pipe & Structural Coating
services.text: Pipe, fittings and structural steel coated to spec, including FBE, ARO, shrink sleeves and Denso.

services.title: Off-site Support Fabrication & Galvanizing
services.text: Pipe supports fabricated and galvanized off site and delivered ready to set.

about.title: Bridging the gap between customer and manufacturer since 1987.
text: SMP Supply is your premiere distributor of pipe, valves, fittings and flanges. We pride ourselves on bridging the gap between customer and manufacturer since 1987.
With over 30 years of experience in the power, petrochemical, and oil & gas industries, we let our relationships do the work so you don't have to.

We achieved our position as a premiere supplier by maintaining stock and distributing only the most trusted brands for our customers, and by backing that stock with valve, machining and structural fabrication services. Five offices in Texas and Louisiana let us serve customers across the United States.
about.imageAlt: Welding on steel workpieces in a fabrication shop

values.title: Trusted brands only
values.text: We maintain stock and distribute only the most trusted brands for our customers.

faqs.q: What if the size or spec I need is not on your stock list?
faqs.a: SMP Supply can source and purchase additional sizes and specs from our manufacturing partners on request. Send the line item and we will quote it.

faqs.q: Can you modify a valve before it ships?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle end modifications, trim changes, pipe pups, valve automation, witness testing and hydro testing.
We have over 30 years of experience in the power, petrochemical, and oil and gas industries.

faqs.q: How do I request a quote?
faqs.a: Email sales@smp-supply.com with your RFQ, or call the Baytown corporate office at (713) 840-9333.
